notes.title: Minor Patch #1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added settings panel with audio sliders.
[*] Added confirmation panel to "Start New" button. 
[*] Added button to lockpicking minigame to see tutorial panel again.

If you encounter any dead end or any other bug don't hesitate to report it.
It's extremely hard to test every corner of this game.

notes.title: Road To Wealth – Now Available!
notes.content: [p]It's time.[/p][p][i]Road To Wealth[/i] is now officially released and available to play![/p][p][/p][p]Step into a text-based RPG full of life-changing choices, unpredictable events, and a touch of luck. From struggling nobody to cunning manipulator, savvy investor, or humble survivor – the path you take is entirely up to you.[/p][p][/p][p]Your journey through greed, power, misfortune, and ambition begins now.[/p][p][/p][p] 🎯 Will you thrive or barely survive?[/p][p]🛒 Get [i]Road To Wealth[/i] now on Steam and start forging your legacy.[/p]

notes.title: Road To Wealth – Release Date Revealed!
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Road To Wealth[/i] will be released on [b]June 20th, 2025[/b]![/p][p]This is not just a story – it’s [i]your[/i] story.
[i]Road To Wealth[/i] is a text-driven RPG where your decisions shape who you become. Make tough choices, gather your wealth, play through unique minigames, and face the unpredictable twists of life.[/p][p]🔹 Branching narratives
🔹 Strategic choices with long-term consequences
🔹 Immersive atmosphere and writing
🔹 Fun and varied minigames integrated into the story[/p][p]Whether you seek power, wealth, or simply want to survive – every playthrough offers a different path.[/p][p]🗓️ [b]Release Date:[/b] [b]June [/b]20th, 2025 💬 Add to your Wishlist and get ready to walk your own [i]Road To Wealth[/i].[/p]
